claims.claim: PROJECT_STATUS.md records a global test suite with "425 failed" in multiple sections (v0.2.0 milestone, Sprint G, SSOT declaration), but an authoritative later baseline document (docs/baseline-full-suite-2026-08-31.md, git tag baseline/full-suite-green-2026-08-31, commit 5fdf34d) records 7784 passed / 143 skipped / 0 failed as of 2026-08-31, directly contradicting the 425-failure figure.
claims.evidence: PROJECT_STATUS.md lines 16-17, 67-68, 199-200 cite "全局测试集存在 425 failed" and "全量测试集 425 failed ⚠️". docs/baseline-full-suite-2026-08-31.md lines 9-19 records "passed: 7784, skipped: 143, failed: 0, errors: 0" with command `.venv/bin/python -m pytest -p no:randomly -q` and states this is the green baseline for git tag baseline/full-suite-green-2026-08-31.

claims.claim: Six skip markers exist in tests/unit/pipeline across four files, all with reason "Test isolation issue - flaky in full suite"; no skip markers found in tests/unit/feedback.
claims.evidence: grep found pytest.mark.skip at tests/unit/pipeline/test_stage_registry_coverage.py:663,847,863; test_synthesize.py:699; test_segment_coverage.py:377,420. All show identical reason string. grep for skip markers in tests/unit/feedback returned zero matches.

claims.claim: Both test directories heavily use mocks: tests/unit/pipeline/test_stage_registry_coverage.py uses MagicMock/AsyncMock/fakes for all pipeline stages and persistence; tests/unit/feedback/test_critics_mock.py is explicitly "Mock-backed coverage tests" with a MockRouter class; tests/unit/feedback/test_integration_phaseB.py uses MagicMock for DB/collector boundaries.
claims.evidence: test_stage_registry_coverage.py lines 13, 54, 74, 188-237 monkeypatches all 7 pipeline stages + persistence writers with fakes/MagicMock. test_critics_mock.py lines 1-7, 21, 53, 64 defines MockRouter and uses it in 30+ test cases. test_integration_phaseB.py line 1 states "mocking DB/collector boundaries" and lines 5, 66, 118-119, 164 use MagicMock.

claims.claim: coverage.xml (timestamp ~2026-08-31) reports line-rate 0.8552 (85.52%, 29938/35008 lines) for src/, which contradicts PROJECT_STATUS.md's claimed "权威基线 77.60%" (8313/10713 lines). The baseline document explicitly states no authoritative line coverage % can be produced due to native extension segfaults during full-suite --cov runs.
claims.evidence: coverage.xml line 3: line-rate="0.8552" lines-valid="35008" lines-covered="29938". PROJECT_STATUS.md line 278-279 claims "权威基线 77.60%ï¼​ï¼​(8313/10713 行)". docs/baseline-full-suite-2026-08-31.md lines 24-31 states "本报告不提供精确行覆盖率百分比...对全量套赛跟 --cov=src 会在原生 C 扩展上 segfault 崱溃，覆盖率工具无法完成".

claims.claim: Three mutually inconsistent coverage figures exist across repo documents: PROJECT_STATUS.md claims 77.60%, COVERAGE_ACTION_PLAN.md claims 77.92% (comprehensive) / 75.39% (line) / 88.45% (branch), coverage.xml artifact shows 85.52% line-rate.
claims.evidence: PROJECT_STATUS.md line 279: "权威基线 77.60%". COVERAGE_ACTION_PLAN.md lines 6-9: "综合覆盖率: 77.92%… 行覆盖率: 75.39%… 分支覆盖率: 88.45%". coverage.xml line 3: line-rate="0.8552" (85.52%). All three documents reference src/ coverage but report different numerators/denominators and methodologies.

claims.claim: Frontend build script is defined as "vue-tsc -b && vite build" (web/package.json:9), but no evidence of recent successful production build exists; frontend.log only shows dev server (vite) runs, and dist/ directory contains assets without verifiable build logs.
claims.evidence: web/package.json line 9: "build": "vue-tsc -b && vite build". web/frontend.log lines 3,6,10-17 show only "vite" dev server with HMR updates, no "vue-tsc" or production build output. /Users/guwj/Documents/audiobook/web/dist/ contains built assets but no timestamped build logs to confirm current pass/fail status.

uncertainties: Cannot execute pytest or frontend build commands (read-only tool constraint); current test pass/fail status and build success are unverified as of this investigation.
The coverage.xml timestamp (1787850369561 ms ≈ 2026-08-27) aligns with baseline doc date (2026-08-31) but exact generation context is unknown.
The "425 failed" in PROJECT_STATUS.md may have been accurate at time of writing (2026-07-20 era) but is contradicted by the later authoritative baseline (2026-08-31).
Whether the skip markers in pipeline tests mask real failures vs. being legitimate flaky-test quarantines cannot be determined without running the full suite.
The extent to which mocks in feedback tests mask integration failures vs. providing necessary unit isolation cannot be assessed without executing tests with and without mocks.
No recent CI/CD pipeline logs (GitHub Actions, etc.) were found in the workspace to corroborate the baseline's 0-failed claim.
